name: Qwen-Image 2512
description: Qwen-Image 2512 (fp8) with the Lightning 8-step LoRA baked in: best-in-class open photoreal humans and text rendering, entire stack Apache 2.0. Around 31 GB of downloads — wants a 24 GB card. Without the Lightning LoRA the model runs 20 steps at cfg 2.5.

prompt_guide.style: Qwen-Image 2512 wants rich, flowing photographic prose — full sentences, never tag soup. One present-tense paragraph: name the subject and action, state every character's wardrobe, then the light source and its quality, and the lens and framing in natural language. The model excels at rendering text: any signage, labels or on-screen writing should be given verbatim in quotes and it will appear letter-perfect. It rewards specificity — material, texture, and spatial relationships described plainly. Avoid comma-separated tags, prompt weights and quality boilerplate.
examples: A street vendor in a white apron flips skewers over a charcoal grill under a canvas awning at night, smoke curling into the string lights. A hand-painted sign behind him reads "OPEN TILL LATE". Medium shot on a 35mm lens, the glowing coals underlighting his face, passersby blurred in the wet street beyond.

An elderly watchmaker in a gray cardigan bends over his bench, a loupe pressed to one eye, tweezers lifting a gear the size of a grain of rice. A single warm desk lamp pools light on the scattered tools and brass parts. Extreme close-up on a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, dust motes drifting through the beam.
